Class Ministry

java.lang.Object
UserFeatures.Ministry
public class Ministry extends Object
The Ministry class represents a government ministry with a name and a general budget. It also includes a static counter to track the number of Ministry objects created. Provides methods for budget searching and formatting.

    • getFormattedBudget

      public static String getFormattedBudget(double budget)
      Formats a given budget value as a string with a German-style grouping separator ('.'). The format uses a thousands separator (e.g., 1000000 becomes "1.000.000").
      Parameters:
      budget - The double value representing the budget to be formatted.
      Returns:
      A string with the formatted budget.
